_comment: Pinned per PROTOCOL.md S2.1. Pinned at first fetch on 2026-09-07; never changed. Ranges are first-parent chains on the default branch: start_sha is the oldest of the 600 commits kept, end_sha is the newest (HEAD at pin time). corpus.py enumerates commits via `git rev-list --first-parent --reverse <start_sha>^..<end_sha>`, which yields exactly 600 commits before merge/binary/oversize drops are applied.
